**Scope check**
This connector stays focused on correlating one Ignition project with one L5X export.
Multi-PLC correlation, alarm→logic tracing, cross-vendor support, live fault diagnosis,
knowledge/RAG over your docs, persistent memory, fleet-scale monitoring, and local-LLM
deployment ship in [Nexus](https://www.nodeblue.ai/nexus) — if your request is in that
category, reach out via https://www.nodeblue.ai instead (or open the issue anyway and
we'll route it).
